_comment: TEMPERATE SPAWN CONTINENT. Tectonic's version of this file is add(0, minecraft:overworld/temperature), which resolves to its config noise - so continent-sized that a whole spawn continent can come out in one band (99.5% frozen on the seed that prompted this). This blends toward Terra Continental's temperate climate (terra_continental:temperature_temperate = 0.4 x a finer temperature noise: mostly temperate, some cool and warm pockets) by terra_continental:spawn_climate_mask, which is 1 across the spawn continent and fades to 0 beyond it: t + mask * (temperate - t). Every other continent keeps Tectonic's climate. Biome selection only; terrain never reads temperature. Strength and radii: [biomes] temperate_spawn_* in terra_continental-common.toml.
